subject: Omicare compliance checklist — BYOK window & audit log granularity
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Omicare compliance checklist — BYOK window & audit log granularity
Attachments: Omicare_Security_Checklist_v2.pdf (pdf)

Team — looping you in on a new procurement thread from Omicare (attached checklist). High level asks we need to triage:  

- BYOK/KMS: they want a customer-managed key option for private deployment and clarity on HSM vs KMS semantics and the onboarding sequence.
- Retention window: they asked if we can support a 90-day short-window carveout for a specific tenant type (PHI-adjacent).
- Audit log granularity: they want per-tenant, per-call traces with operation-level metadata and retention/ingest details.
- Evidence pack: SOC-2 artifacts + sample event rows they can ingest for their audit team.

Can we split ownership and surface: (1) minimal implementation approach and timeline (2) blockers (product/infra/legal) and (3) evidence we can provide in 5 business days vs items that require engineering changes (est. 3 weeks).

My suggested owners: Ben — logs/audit granularity; Priyom — BYOK onboarding sequence and KMS ops; Grace — evidence packaging; Marissa — release/roadmap impacts and timeline. I will coordinate with Legal/Procurement and reply to the customer with a MAP.

Quick ask: if any of you see immediate SSO/SSO-token impacts or billing/contract items that will block, flag them now.

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Security PM, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Omicare compliance checklist — BYOK window & audit log granularity
Attachments: evidence_sample_rows.csv

On Sun, May 9, 2027 at 08:12 Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Team — looping you in on a new procurement thread from Omicare (attached checklist). High level asks we need to triage:...

Thanks Naomi — quick reactions and proposed owners look good. I sketched a pragmatic approach below:

1) Audit logs (Ben)
   - Deliverable: doc + sample CSV of per-call rows (attached) and config knobs we can expose for tenant-level retention.
   - ETA: 5 business days for doc + sample; production changes (policy-driven per-tenant retention) would be a 3-week sprint.

2) BYOK/KMS (Priyom)
   - Deliverable: onboarding sequence doc (steps to import/rotate keys, recommended HSM profile, fallback) and a short checklist we can give to Omicare to sign off.
   - Blocking questions: does Omicare insist on escrow/HSM-backed custody or is a cloud-KMS CMK acceptable? Please confirm.

3) Evidence pack (Grace)
   - Deliverable: SOC2 references + sanitized sample rows + guidance for auditors on log schema and retention guarantees.

4) Roadmap/Procurement (Marissa)
   - I will surface any SLA/price delta for a 90-day short-window retention exception and document required engineering changes for per-tenant logs.

If everyone is good, I suggest we consolidate into a single MAP and reply to Omicare by EOD. If any of you need extra cycles, tell me now.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Product Operations
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Julia Park <julia.park@omicare.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@omicare.com, security@omicare.com
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Omicare compliance checklist — BYOK window & audit log granularity

Hi Naomi/Marissa — thanks for the quick acknowledgement and the suggested owners. A couple clarifications from our side that will influence the MAP: 

- Key custody: Omicare prefers HSM-backed keys (FIPS 140-2/3) for production private deployments. If Redwood offers a CMK workflow without HSM we need to understand compensating controls.
- Retention carveout: The 90-day window is a must for our PHI-adjacent tenant; we are open to a technical implementation that scopes to tenant IDs.
- Audit detail: We need event-level fields for who-called-what (caller identity, route, response-code, token-id) and a guaranteed export cadence (daily delta export plus 90-day retention).
- Evidence: can you provide a sample manifest of the items you will include in the evidence pack (SOC-2 sections, sample logs, key rotation docs, KMS config export)?

We also need a Mutual Action Plan with dates and who signs each item (security sign-off, procurement, legal). Our procurement team would like an initial MAP within 48 hours.

Julia Park
Head of Cloud Security, Omicare Health
julia.park@omicare.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@omicare.com>, procurement@omicare.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Omicare compliance checklist — BYOK window & audit log granularity
Attachments: Omicare_Security_Checklist_v2.pdf; evidence_sample_rows.csv
Related-Links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/OMC-789, https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcDocEvidence

Julia — thanks for the clarifications. Draft MAP below (please confirm owners/dates). We can get the initial deliverables to you within 48 hours for review.

Mutual Action Plan (draft)
- Day 0 (Today): Redwood confirms owners and scope (this thread). Owner: Naomi (coordination).
- Day 1–2: Deliverables (48 hrs):
  - BYOK/KMS sequence doc & recommended HSM profile (Priyom).
  - Evidence manifest + sample CSV rows and SOC-2 section mapping (Grace).
  - Audit log sample + config options for tenant retention (Ben).
- Day 3–10: Integration/Decision window: Omicare to confirm HSM requirement vs acceptable compensating controls; procurement & legal review.
- If Omicare requires HSM-backed key custody and we need product changes: target engineering sprint (3 weeks) to enable HSM-backed key path and per-tenant retention policy. Marissa will provide cost/SLA delta.

Open questions for you (explicit):
1) Confirm HSM requirement: Is HSM mandatory or will documented compensating controls (e.g., restricted key import + rotation policy + attestation) suffice for an initial pilot?
2) Confirm whether the 90-day retention applies to all PHI-adjacent tenants or a single tenant ID (affects scope).

Next steps (from Redwood):
- Priyom will produce the onboarding checklist and call out any infra-level blockers.
- Ben will attach a sanitized sample of the event rows and a short doc describing the schema and retention knobs.
- Grace will assemble the evidence manifest (SOC-2 mapping + sample files) and put items in the shared Drive folder (link above).
- Marissa will produce an initial cost/impact note if the HSM path is required.

If Omicare can confirm answers to the two open questions by EOD tomorrow we will lock dates and produce the 48-hour deliverables.

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Security PM, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
